positive.sql: SELECT person.name AS person_name, menu.pizza_name AS pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM person_order, person, menu, pizzeria WHERE person.id = person_order.person_id AND menu.id = person_order.menu_id AND pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

negative.why: пропущено соединение с pizzeria: каждая пицца со всеми пиццериями
negative.sql: SELECT person.name AS person_name, menu.pizza_name AS pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id CROSS JOIN pizzeria ORDER BY person_name, pizza_name, pizzeria_name;

negative.why: пиццерия определена не через меню, а по id заказа
negative.sql: SELECT person.name AS person_name, menu.pizza_name AS pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = person_order.id ORDER BY person_name, pizza_name, pizzeria_name;

SELECT person.name AS person_name, menu.pizza_name AS pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id ORDER BY person_name DESC, pizza_name DESC, pizzeria_name DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT person.name AS person_name, menu.pizza_name AS pizza_name, pizzeria.name AS pizzeria_name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id JOIN menu ON menu.id = person_order.menu_id JOIN pizzeria ON pizzeria.id = menu.pizzeria_id ORDER BY person_name, pizza_name, pizzeria_name;
